senses.gloss: जड (I) a. (f. डा) 1. Cold, frigid; 2. paralysed, motionless, जडीकृतस्त्र्यंबकवीक्षणेन R.ii.42; 3. apathetic, inappreciative, वेदाभ्यासजडः कथं नु विषयव्यावृत्तकौतूहलः Vikr.i.; 4. senseless, stupid, dull, irrational, जडे परिजने दीर्घां कथां कुर्वंति Am.S.75; 5. unable to learn the Vedas; 6. dumb; 7. stupifying.

जड (I) a. (f. डा) 1. Cold, frigid; 2. paralysed, motionless, जडीकृतस्त्र्यंबकवीक्षणेन R.ii.42; 3. apathetic, inappreciative, वेदाभ्यासजडः कथं नु विषयव्यावृत्तकौतूहलः Vikr.i.; 4. senseless, stupid, dull, irrational, जडे परिजने दीर्घां कथां कुर्वंति Am.S.75; 5. unable to learn the Vedas; 6. dumb; 7. stupifying.
जड-ता f. 1. dullness, disinclination to work; 2. dullness considered as one of the 33 subordinate feelings (in rhetoric); 3. stupidity, ignorance.
जडिमन् m. 1. Frigidity; 2. stupidity; 3. dullness, apathy.
जाड्य n. 1. Coldness, frigidity; 2. apathy, sluggishness, inactivity; 3. dulness of intellect, stupidity, जाड्यं धियो हरति सिंचति वाचि सत्यम् Bhartr.ii.23, जाड्यं ह्रीमति गण्यते ii.54.
